Unconscious.label: Unconscious Level
Unconscious.level1: The Character enters a semi-awake state of narcolepsy, and possibly might fall asleep standing for a few seconds. A Character who is sleeping or has passed out, cannot attempt any Actions or Movement, and neither is aware of their surroundings.The Character can attempt to awake in case of something moves them a bit, or in case of any loud noises. At the end of each Round, the unconscious Character attempting to wake up might attempt an Endurance roll (Free Roll), and if successful they wake up.
Unconscious.level2: The Character slowly loses their standing and falls asleep for some minutes. The Character further receives the Condition: Knocked Down. A Character who is sleeping or has passed out, cannot attempt any Actions or Movement, and neither is aware of their surroundings. The Character can attempt to awake in case of something heavily shakes them, or in case of hearing loud noises from up close. At the end of each Round, the unconscious Character attempting to wake up might attempt an Endurance roll (Free Roll), and if successful they wake up.
Unconscious.level3: The Character slowly loses their standing and falls into a deep, passed-out sleep for some hours. A Character who is sleeping or has passed out, cannot attempt any Actions or Movement, and neither is aware of their surroundings. The Character further receives the Condition: Knocked Down. The Character can attempt to awake in case of free-falling, or in case of hearing extremely loud noises from up close. At the end of each Round, the unconscious Character attempting to wake up might attempt an Endurance roll (Free Roll), and if successful they wake up.
Unconscious.level4: The Character collapses into a comatose state for days. A Character who is sleeping or has passed out, cannot attempt any Actions or Movement, and neither is aware of their surroundings. The Character further receives the Condition: Knocked Down. The Character must spend 1 * @METAFA(hand-fingers-crossed) Destiny to attempt to be awakened from the coma. At the end of each Round, the unconscious Character attempting to wake up might attempt an Endurance roll (Free Roll), and if successful they wake up.
Unconscious.level5: The Character collapses into a deep coma for an unknown amount of time. A Character who is sleeping or has passed out, cannot attempt any Actions or Movement, and neither is aware of their surroundings. The Character further receives the Condition: Knocked Down. The Character must spend 2 * @METAFA(hand-fingers-crossed) Destiny to attempt to be awakened from the coma. At the end of each Round, the unconscious Character attempting to wake up might attempt an Endurance roll (Free Roll), and if successful they wake up.

Asphyxiation.label: Asphyxiation Level
Asphyxiation.level1: A Character who cannot breathe oxygen is asphyxiating. At Asphyxiation 1 the Character has trouble breathing. The Character collapse into the floor for a couple of minutes. At the end of each Round, the asphyxiating Character must attempt an Endurance roll (Free Roll). Failure on that roll causes the Character to increase the Condition to Asphyxiation 2.
Asphyxiation.level2: A Character who cannot breathe oxygen is asphyxiating. At Asphyxiation 2 the Character's brain is not being properly oxygenized. The Character may enter a comatose state for days. At the end of each Round, the asphyxiating Character must attempt an Endurance roll (Free Roll). Failure on that roll causes the Character to receive the Conditions: Knocked Down and Unconscious 2, up until the Character receives oxygen again.
Asphyxiation.level3: A Character who cannot breathe oxygen is asphyxiating. At Asphyxiation 3 the Character will being chocking and gasping for air. The Character may enter a comatose state for days. At the end of each Round, the asphyxiating Character must attempt an Endurance roll (Free Roll). Failure on that roll causes the Character to receive 2 Elemental Damage and the Conditions: Confused 2, Disoriented 2, Knocked Down and Unconscious 3, up until the Character receives oxygen again.
Asphyxiation.level4: A Character who cannot breathe oxygen is asphyxiating. At Asphyxiation 4 the Character is suffocating. The Character may enter a comatose state for days. At the end of each Round, the asphyxiating Character must attempt an Endurance roll (Free Roll). Failure on that roll causes the Character to receive 4d10 + 40 Psychic Damage the Conditions: Knocked Down and Unconscious 4, up until the Character receives oxygen again.
Asphyxiation.level5: A Character who cannot breathe oxygen is asphyxiating. At Asphyxiation 4 the Character is receiving brain damage due to lack of oxygen. The Character may enter a comatose state for days. At the end of each Round, the asphyxiating Character must attempt an Endurance roll (Free Roll). Failure on that roll causes the Character to receive 6d10 + 60 Psychic Damage the Conditions: Disconnected 4, Knocked Down and Unconscious 4, up until the Character receives oxygen again.

Fatigue.label: Fatigue Level
Fatigue.level1: You are tired, you cannot attempt any Focused Actions until you rest.
Fatigue.level2: You are worn out, you cannot attempt any Focused Actions or Extra Actions until you rest.
Fatigue.level3: You are weary, you cannot attempt any Focused Actions, Extra Actions or Reactions until you rest.
Fatigue.level4: You are exhausted, you cannot attempt any Focused Actions, Extra Actions, Reactions or Movement until you rest. You can still forgo your Main Action slot to gain another Movement.
Fatigue.level5: You are collapsing, you cannot attempt any Focused Actions, Extra Actions, Reactions, Movement or Main Actions until you rest. You can only utter a few words and crawl 1 Hexagon per Turn.

SETTINGS.metaAdvancedLoggingHint: The Console helps you identify any issues or potential bugs in regards to Metanthropes System for Foundry VTT. Enable this setting to see even more detailed logs in the Console. You can press 'F12' in the Foundry Client or 'CTRL+SHIFT+i' in a Chrome-ium web browser to show the Console.
SETTINGS.metaNetworkLoggingHint: Enabling this setting will replay all Metanthropes console messages from all connected Clients, in the Active GM's console, for debugging purposes. Any Objects returned as part of error messages, are serialized before transmitting. This Setting should be disabled during normal play to reduce network load & message spam.
SETTINGS.forceMigrationHint: Forces the System to migrate this World's data to the latest version. Migration happens on the first World load after an update, and you can force to run it again by enabling this setting. To get support with any issues after updating, contact us at support@metanthropes.com or join our Discord. This setting requires a reload and it will be disabled automatically once it completes.
SETTINGS.metaPauseHint: Enable this setting to automatically un-pause the World after initializing the System and Modules.
SETTINGS.welcomeMsgHint: Display the System Welcome Message on the next World load.
SETTINGS.metaWelcomeHint: Enable this setting to display the Metanthropes Welcome Journal when the World loads.
SETTINGS.metaInstallHint: Enable to show the System Demo Adventure Importer on the next startup.
